titulo: How to Stop Hitting Snooze (Cella, Snooze Number Four)
descripcion:
Snooze number four. Her sister calls it peasant behavior. Cella tries to get up and falls straight back into bed. Next day: one alarm, and she's up on the first beep.

How do you stop hitting snooze? The tricks people swear by are simple: put the alarm across the room so you have to stand up to turn it off, set it for the time you actually need to get up instead of stacking alarms, and keep the same wake-up time every day. The first morning is the hardest.

Finally. Some class.
